events.evidence: The Saudi-led coalition launches airstrikes on Sanaa International Airport in the Yemeni capital Sanaa
The Tigray Defense Forces withdraws all its troops from the Afar and Amhara regions of Ethiopia
German Chancellor Olaf Scholz and 16 state premiers agree to tighten the restrictions beginning on December 28

label.note: Mixed geopolitics: Yemen airstrikes adverse, Tigray withdrawal supportive; European COVID restrictions tighten.
